what: Hand-checked truth for the episodes the pipeline has actually stored, so a change to it can be scored rather than argued about.
how: The set is the nine episode rows found in the two live saves and graded by hand in data/retired/20260903_2330_summaries_plan/REPORT.md. Two were wrong, four thin, three right but noisy; none clean.

Truth comes from sources the pipeline did not read when it stored the row: English Wikipedia's episode-list article, the same summary mirrored on the episode page of his own list's site, and the show's own official あらすじ page. Where those disagreed the episode was dropped rather than guessed at.

Each scene carries `keys`: alternative strings, any ONE of which counts as that scene being named. They are written for a digest in Japanese with an English source behind it, so both are listed. `outcome` is what the scene comes to, and `contradicts` are phrasings that state the opposite -- the failure both wrong digests made.
`invents` are details that appear in no source for the episode and were written by a digest anyway.
The headline number is episodes with NO error and at least two-thirds of their scenes named, in order.

scenes.what: Yuudai assumes the book Hitoha is reading is pornography; it is a Gachi Ranger guidebook, and he takes it as her being a fan
scenes.outcome: it ends with him pulling Yabe's trousers down in front of her

scenes.what: Yabe tries to run a talk-show corner with Mitsuba
scenes.outcome: she is only interested in eating

scenes.outcome: Futaba spots her and Hitoha cannot get away after pulling the hat down over her eyes

scenes.what: On New Year's Day Futaba and Mitsuba fight over a new pair of pants and they blow away
scenes.outcome: she chases them to the shrine and they land in the offertory box

scenes.what: Mitsuba catches a cold and is worse company than usual when Miku, Yuki and Miyashita visit
scenes.outcome: they struggle to get a suppository into her, and it turns out to have been her father's haemorrhoid medicine

episodes.why_not_scored: The show is not on his mirrored list, so there is no episode page on the list site, and English Wikipedia has no `List of Chiikawa episodes` article. Every source that could establish the truth is one the pipeline itself would read, and grading a pipeline against its own output proves nothing. Kept in the file as the case with no English tier at all.
